VII. OTHER RELEVANT FACTS
1. That, as per case of claimant on 15.07.2021, the Appellant's son
Lalit Dahiya was going from village Nausa, Thana Tala, to his
brother-in-law Ramdayal Dahiya's house in Alwar by
motorcycle. As soon as he reached near village Hinita on
Semriya Rea Road at around 06:30 pm, the Respondent no 1,
driving very fast and carelessly, suddenly applied brakes in the
middle of the road without giving any indication, due to which
the motorcycle of the Appellant's son Lalit collided with the
truck vehicle number UP 64 T 9503, as a result of which the
Appellant's son suffered serious internal injuries in the head,
face and other parts of the body and Ram Dayal also suffered
injuries.
2. Thereafter, the Appellant's son, who was injured in the accident,
was taken to Sanjay Gandhi Medical College, Rewa by 108
ambulance for treatment by the people present on the spot,
where the Appellant's son was given first aid and MLC. Due to
his critical condition, he was admitted for better treatment
where the Appellant's son remained unconscious from
15.07.2021 to 22.07.2021. Due to no improvement in the health
of the Appellant's son, he was referred to a higher center by the
doctors for better treatment. The Appellant took her son from
Medical College Rewa to Ahmedabad by a private ambulance
for treatment where the Appellant's son's X-ray examination
and other tests were done, thereafter the Appellant's son's head
was operated upon and other injuries were treated properly. He
--- PAGE 10 ---
7
died during treatment on 23.07.2021. The Appellant's deceased
son's PM was done at Civil Hospital Ahmedabad.
3. That, appellant has filed the claim before the learned tribunal
below and claim the amount of Rs. 18,00,000/- arising due to
pain and injury. After considering all the facts and
circumstances of the case learned Tribunal has awarded
14,44,440/- which is very low and unfair in the eyes of law,
hence the following appeal
GROUNDS OF APPEAL
1. That, the impugned award tribunal is erroneous and liable to be
modify by enhancing the amount of compensation.
2. That, the tribunal below has not considered the evidence on record
in proper manner and awarded less amount.
3. That, the learned tribunal below has not considered that deceased
earns Rs.1500/- per day and awarded less amount.
4. That, before the accident Deceased was young and healthy person,
also the care taker of other dependents of the family however, after
the incident all the dependents suffering with the serious problem
for their livelihood.
5. Because, court below has also not given any amount in respect of
loss of future prospect and very less amount has been given for the
mental and physical agony and pain for the family members of the
deceased.
--- PAGE 11 ---
8
6. That, other grounds will be raised at time of the hearing.
(IX) RELIEF CLAIMS IN APPEAL
It is therefore prayed that this Hon’ble Court may kindly be
pleased to set aside the impugned award dated 21-08 -2024 (Annexure
A-1) so far and further this Hon’ble Court may kindly be pleased
enhance the appropriate compensation by allowing the claim appeal
filed by the appellant, in the interest of justice.
(X) CAVEAT
That, no notice of lodging a caveat by the opposite party is received.
